answer: A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ridge queue naming the onyx that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the zephyr record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
